name: heavy and light artillary support military units
short_description: This mod adds them for support and artillery as well. This would open an opportunity to fix/improve some current complaints with war. Introducing: a) Engineer corps (Heavy Support): would speed up sieges, remove getting frozen in winters and give minor movemnt speed over rivers. Super expansive; Heavy Artillarly would be superior for sieging down fortifications while Light Artillary would shine in battles.
